statement: An epicardial fibrin patch carrying embryonic-stem-cell-derived cardiovascular progenitors was delivered to six patients with ischaemic left ventricular dysfunction; the procedure was feasible with no tumour and no sustained arrhythmia reported, and the authors did not claim an efficacy conclusion.

context.intervention: ESC-derived cardiovascular progenitor patch during CABG

measurement.assay: safety, feasibility, symptomatic and imaging follow-up
measurement.endpoint: safety and feasibility at one year
measurement.effect: feasible; no tumour or sustained arrhythmia reported in six patients

limitations: six patients, all undergoing concurrent bypass surgery, so any functional change is confounded

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
